# files_database_destination (Data Source)

A Database Destination lets an Automation append rows to an existing table. Each destination references a credential in the Secret Store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "files_database_destination" "example_database_destination" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Database Destination ID.

### Read-Only

- `config` (Attributes) Provider settings for the destination. Use the schema matching provider. The connection address and table are fixed after creation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `created_at` (String) When the destination was created.
- `name` (String) Name of the destination.
- `provider_` (String) Database provider.
- `secret_id` (Number) ID of a Secret in the same Workspace. Use a Token Secret for Snowflake, a service account Key/Value Secret for BigQuery, or a Username/Password Secret for a database login.
- `updated_at` (String) When the destination was last updated.
- `workspace_id` (Number) Workspace ID. 0 means the default workspace.
